\begin{proof}
Apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.
For each \(i,j,h\), apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:inward-free-bridges-are-chains-or-long-runs} with
\[
  (\lambda,\sigma,\beta,K,L)
  =
  (\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,2K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i).
\]
This gives
\[
\begin{aligned}
  P_{i,j,h}^{\rm pre,br,free,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}(s,p)
  \le&
  \mathfrak P_{Q,\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,j,
    2K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i,h+1}^{G\to H,
    {\rm rad,tan,pre,out,per,stair,loc,chain,short}}(s,p)
\\
  &+
  W_{\beta_i,p}\,T_{i,j}^{\rm long}(s,p).
\end{aligned}
\]
Since \(h+1\ge2\),
Corollary~\ref{cor:locally-short-staircase-chains-are-prefix-record-spread}
with \(\ell=h+1\) bounds the chain profile by
\(P_{i,j}^{\rm pre,rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}\).  Substituting these
inequalities into the
coefficient-\(2B_i^{\rm ch}B_i^{\rm br,ch}B_i^{\rm br,recbr,ch}\)
inward-free bridge-record-record-record sum gives
\[
  2B_i^{\rm ch}B_i^{\rm br,ch}B_i^{\rm br,recbr,ch}
  B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
copies of the prefix-record profile and the same number of additional copies
of \(W_{\beta_i,p}T_{i,j}^{\rm long}\).  Combining these with the existing
coefficient
\[
  2B_i^{\rm ch}B_i^{\rm br,ch}B_i^{\rm br,recbr,ch}
  +2B_i^{\rm ch}B_i^{\rm br,ch}+2B_i^{\rm ch}+3
\]
on the long-run term gives the displayed inequality.
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}
Apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:record-absorbed-inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.
For each \(i,j\), apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:short-prefix-record-spread-persistent-return-split} with
\[
  (\lambda,\sigma,\beta,K,L)
  =
  (\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,2K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i).
\]
This gives
\[
\begin{aligned}
  P_{i,j}^{\rm pre,rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}(s,p)
  \le&
  P_{i,j}^{\rm pre,per,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}(s,p)
\\
  &+
  R_{i,j}^{\rm spr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}(s,p)
\\
  &+
  R_{i,j+1}^{\rm spr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}(s,p),
\end{aligned}
\]
because the return threshold \(4K\) in the general split is
\(8K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,ch}\).  Substituting into the coefficient
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,ch}
  =
  2B_i^{\rm ch}B_i^{\rm br,ch}B_i^{\rm br,recbr,ch}
    B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
bridge-record-record-record prefix-record term gives the displayed
inequality.  The new coefficients are fixed by the finite ladder parameters,
and the only nonconstant losses remain the existing slab-width factors.
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}
Apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:persistent-bridge-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.
For each \(i,j\), apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:persistent-prefix-levels-form-ordered-ladders} with
\[
  (\lambda,\sigma,\beta,K,L)
  =
  (\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,4K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i).
\]
Then apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:ordered-ladders-have-bounded-successor-gaps} with the same
parameters.  Since the bounded-successor reduction doubles \(K\), and
\[
  B_{\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,4K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,ch}}
  =
  \left\lceil
    \frac{64K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,ch}\beta_i}{\Theta_i}
  \right\rceil+1
  =
  B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},
\]
the two inequalities give
\[
  P_{i,j}^{\rm pre,per,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}(s,p)
  \le
  P_{i,j}^{\rm pre,pair,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}(s,p).
\]
Substituting this into the coefficient
\(D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,ch}\) persistent
bridge-record-record-record term gives the displayed bound.  The new cutoff
\(B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}\) is fixed by the finite ladder
parameters, and no new nonconstant multiplicative loss is introduced.
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}
Apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.
For each \(i,j,h\), apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:inward-free-bridges-are-chains-or-long-runs} with
\[
  (\lambda,\sigma,\beta,K,L)
  =
  (\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    2K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i).
\]
This gives
\[
\begin{aligned}
  P_{i,j,h}^{\rm pre,br,free,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}(s,p)
  \le&
  \mathfrak P_{Q,\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,j,
    2K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i,h+1}^{G\to H,
    {\rm rad,tan,pre,out,per,stair,loc,chain,short}}(s,p)
\\
  &+
  W_{\beta_i,p}\,T_{i,j}^{\rm long}(s,p).
\end{aligned}
\]
Since \(h+1\ge2\),
Corollary~\ref{cor:locally-short-staircase-chains-are-prefix-record-spread}
with \(\ell=h+1\) bounds the chain profile by \(P_{i,j}^{\rm rec4}\).
Substituting these inequalities into the
inward-free bridge sum with coefficient
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
gives \(D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}\) copies of the prefix-record
profile and the same number of additional copies of
\(W_{\beta_i,p}T_{i,j}^{\rm long}\).  Combining these with the existing
long-run coefficient
\[
  A_i^{\rm long,br,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
gives the displayed inequality.
\end{proof}

bridge-record-record-record-record prefix-record term gives the displayed

\begin{proof}
Apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:persistent-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.
For each \(i,j\), apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:persistent-prefix-levels-form-ordered-ladders} with
\[
  (\lambda,\sigma,\beta,K,L)
  =
  (\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    4K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i).
\]
Then apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:ordered-ladders-have-bounded-successor-gaps} with the same
parameters.  Since the bounded-successor reduction doubles \(K\), and
\[
  B_{\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    4K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}}
  =
  \left\lceil
    \frac{64K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}\beta_i}{\Theta_i}
  \right\rceil+1
  =
  B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},
\]
the two inequalities give
\[
  P_{i,j}^{\rm per4}(s,p)
  \le
  P_{i,j}^{\rm pair5}(s,p).
\]
Substituting this into the coefficient
\(D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}\) persistent
bridge-record-record-record-record term gives the displayed bound.  The new
cutoff \(B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}\) is fixed by the finite
ladder parameters, and no new nonconstant multiplicative loss is introduced.
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}

Corollary~\ref{cor:confined-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.

Corollary~\ref{cor:confined-bridges-inward-free-or-returning} with
\[
  (\lambda,\sigma,\beta,K,L)
  =
  (\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i).

\[

  =
  P_{i,j,h}^{\rm pre,br,free,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},
  \qquad
  R_{i,j,h}^{\rm ret5}
  =
  R_{i,j,h}^{\rm spr,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},
\]
and
\[
  P_{i,j,h}^{\rm br5}(s,p)
  \le
  P_{i,j,h}^{\rm ifr5}(s,p)
  +
  R_{i,j,h}^{\rm ret5}(s,p).
\]

\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
gives the displayed inequality.  The added \(h\)-sum is finite and
independent of \(p\), and no new nonconstant multiplicative loss is introduced.
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}
Apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.
For each \(i,j,h\), apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:inward-free-bridges-are-chains-or-long-runs} with
\[
  (\lambda,\sigma,\beta,K,L)
  =
  (\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    2K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i).
\]
This gives
\[
\begin{aligned}
  P_{i,j,h}^{\rm pre,br,free,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}(s,p)
  \le&
  \mathfrak P_{Q,\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,j,
    2K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i,h+1}^{G\to H,
    {\rm rad,tan,pre,out,per,stair,loc,chain,short}}(s,p)
\\
  &+
  W_{\beta_i,p}\,T_{i,j}^{\rm long}(s,p).
\end{aligned}
\]
Since \(h+1\ge2\),
Corollary~\ref{cor:locally-short-staircase-chains-are-prefix-record-spread}
with \(\ell=h+1\) bounds the chain profile by \(P_{i,j}^{\rm rec5}\).
Substituting these inequalities into the inward-free bridge sum with
coefficient
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
gives \(D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}\) copies of the
prefix-record profile and the same number of additional copies of
\(W_{\beta_i,p}T_{i,j}^{\rm long}\).  Combining these with the existing
long-run coefficient
\[
  A_i^{\rm long,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
gives the displayed inequality.
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}
Apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:persistent-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.
For each \(i,j\), apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:persistent-prefix-levels-form-ordered-ladders} with
\[
  (\lambda,\sigma,\beta,K,L)
  =
  (\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    4K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i).
\]
Then apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:ordered-ladders-have-bounded-successor-gaps} with the same
parameters.  Since the bounded-successor reduction doubles \(K\), and
\[
\begin{aligned}
  B_{\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    4K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}}
  &=
  \left\lceil
    \frac{64K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}\beta_i}{\Theta_i}
  \right\rceil+1
\\
  &=
  B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},
\end{aligned}
\]
the two inequalities give
\[
  P_{i,j}^{\rm per5}(s,p)
  \le
  P_{i,j}^{\rm pair6}(s,p).
\]
Substituting this into the coefficient
\(D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}\) persistent
bridge-record-record-record-record-record term gives the displayed bound.  The
new cutoff \(B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}\) is fixed by the
finite ladder parameters, and no new nonconstant multiplicative loss is
introduced.
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}

\[

  =

This gives

Substituting this bound in the fixed-gap sum with coefficient

conclusion is unchanged.

\begin{proof}
Apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:confined-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.
For each \(i,j,h\), apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:confined-bridges-inward-free-or-returning} with
\[
  (\lambda,\sigma,\beta,K,L)
  =
  (\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i).
\]
This gives
\[
  P_{i,j,h}^{\rm ifr6}
  =
  P_{i,j,h}^{\rm pre,br,free,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},
  \qquad
  R_{i,j,h}^{\rm ret6}
  =
  R_{i,j,h}^{\rm spr,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},
\]
and
\[
  P_{i,j,h}^{\rm br6}(s,p)
  \le
  P_{i,j,h}^{\rm ifr6}(s,p)
  +
  R_{i,j,h}^{\rm ret6}(s,p).
\]
Substituting into the confined bridge sum with coefficient
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
gives the displayed inequality.  The added \(h\)-sum is finite and
independent of \(p\), and no new nonconstant multiplicative loss is introduced.
\end{proof}

and after replacing the long-run coefficient
\[

\]
by
\[

\begin{proof}
Apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.
For each \(i,j,h\), apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:inward-free-bridges-are-chains-or-long-runs} with
\[
  (\lambda,\sigma,\beta,K,L)
  =
  (\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    2K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i).

This gives
\[
\begin{aligned}
  &P_{i,j,h}^{\rm pre,br,free,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}(s,p)
\\
  &\quad\le
  \mathfrak P_{Q,\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,j,

    {\rm rad,tan,pre,out,per,stair,loc,chain,short}}(s,p)
  +
  W_{\beta_i,p}\,T_{i,j}^{\rm long}(s,p).
\end{aligned}
\]
Since \(h+1\ge2\),
Corollary~\ref{cor:locally-short-staircase-chains-are-prefix-record-spread}
with \(\ell=h+1\) bounds the chain profile by \(P_{i,j}^{\rm rec6}\).
Substituting these inequalities into the inward-free bridge sum with
coefficient
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
gives \(D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}\) copies of the
prefix-record profile and the same number of additional copies of
\(W_{\beta_i,p}T_{i,j}^{\rm long}\).  Combining these with the existing
long-run coefficient
\[
  A_i^{\rm long,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
gives the displayed replacement.
\end{proof}

\\

\begin{corollary}[Seventh bounded-gap bridge finite ladder]
\label{cor:bounded-gap-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}

    B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}}^{G\to H,

\]
Then, for all \(p\) sufficiently close to \(\pc(H)\), the finite ladder of

\[

by

  \sum_{j=0}^{J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}-1}
  P_{i,j}^{\rm pair7}.
\]
All other terms from that finite ladder, including the new adjacent
return-spread family \(R_{i,j}^{\rm spr7}\), the

\(R_{i,j,h}^{\rm ret6}\), the adjacent return-spread family
\(R_{i,j}^{\rm spr6}\), all retained older return-spread and bridge-return

\begin{proof}
Apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:persistent-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.
For each \(i,j\), apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:persistent-prefix-levels-form-ordered-ladders} with
\[
  (\lambda,\sigma,\beta,K,L)
  =
  (\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    4K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i).
\]
Then apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:ordered-ladders-have-bounded-successor-gaps} with the same
parameters.  Since the bounded-successor reduction doubles \(K\), and
\[
\begin{aligned}
  B_{\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    4K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}}
  &=
  \left\lceil
    \frac{
      64K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}\beta_i
    }{\Theta_i}
  \right\rceil+1
\\
  &=
  B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},
\end{aligned}
\]
the two inequalities give
\[
  P_{i,j}^{\rm per6}(s,p)
  \le
  P_{i,j}^{\rm pair7}(s,p).
\]
Substituting this into the coefficient
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
persistent-prefix term gives the displayed replacement.  The new cutoff is
fixed by the finite ladder parameters, and no new nonconstant multiplicative
loss is introduced.
\end{proof}

\begin{corollary}[Seventh record-absorbed finite ladder]
\label{cor:record-absorbed-inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}
In the setting of
Corollary~\ref{cor:inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder},

\[
\begin{aligned}
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}

\\

\\

\\

\\

by

and after replacing the long-run coefficient

by

spread family \(R_{i,j,h}^{\rm ret7}\), the adjacent return-spread family

families, confined fixed-gap staircase and bridge profiles, enlarged
spread-return profiles, and exact-level return profiles, are unchanged.

prefix-record profiles, the retained return-spread and bridge-return profiles
named above, confined fixed-gap staircase and bridge profiles, long-run
profiles, enlarged spread-return profiles, and ordinary exact-level

\begin{proof}
Apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.
For each \(i,j,h\), apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:inward-free-bridges-are-chains-or-long-runs} with
\[
  (\lambda,\sigma,\beta,K,L)
  =
  (\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    2K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i).
\]
This gives
\[
\begin{aligned}
  &P_{i,j,h}^{\rm pre,br,free,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}(s,p)
\\
  &\quad\le
  \mathfrak P_{Q,\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,j,
    2K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i,h+1}^{G\to H,
    {\rm rad,tan,pre,out,per,stair,loc,chain,short}}(s,p)
  +
  W_{\beta_i,p}\,T_{i,j}^{\rm long}(s,p).
\end{aligned}
\]
Since \(h+1\ge2\),
Corollary~\ref{cor:locally-short-staircase-chains-are-prefix-record-spread}
with \(\ell=h+1\) bounds the chain profile by \(P_{i,j}^{\rm rec7}\).
Substituting these inequalities into the inward-free bridge sum with
coefficient
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
gives \(D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}\) copies of
the prefix-record profile and the same number of additional copies of
\(W_{\beta_i,p}T_{i,j}^{\rm long}\).  Combining these with the existing
long-run coefficient
\[
  A_i^{\rm long,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
gives the displayed replacement.
\end{proof}

by

\begin{proof}

For each \(i,j\), apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:persistent-prefix-levels-form-ordered-ladders} with
\[
  (\lambda,\sigma,\beta,K,L)
  =
  (\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    4K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i).
\]
Then apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:ordered-ladders-have-bounded-successor-gaps} with the same
parameters.  Since the bounded-successor reduction doubles \(K\), and
\[
\begin{aligned}
  &B_{\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    4K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}}
\\
  &\quad=
  \left\lceil

      64K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}\beta_i

\\

\]
the two inequalities give
\[
  P_{i,j}^{\rm per7}(s,p)

\]
Substituting this into the coefficient
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}

Corollary~\ref{cor:fixed-gap-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.

Corollary~\ref{cor:fixed-gap-pairs-have-confined-bridges} with
\[
  (\lambda,\sigma,\beta,K,L)
  =
  (\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i).
\]
This gives
\[
  P_{i,j,h}^{\rm gap8}(s,p)
  \le
  P_{i,j,h}^{\rm br8}(s,p).
\]
Substituting this bound in the fixed-gap sum with coefficient
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
gives the displayed replacement.  No new variable coefficient is introduced,
so the exponent conclusion is unchanged.
\end{proof}

\begin{corollary}[Eighth inward-free bridge finite ladder]
\label{cor:inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}
In the setting of
Corollary~\ref{cor:confined-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder},
use the notation from that corollary.  For
\(0\le j<J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}\) and
\(1\le h\le B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}\),
write
\[
\begin{aligned}
  P_{i,j,h}^{\rm ifr8}(s,p)
  &:=
  P_{i,j,h}^{\rm pre,br,free,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}(s,p)
\\
  &:=
  \mathfrak P_{
    \substack{
      Q,\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,j,\\
      2K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},\\
      L_i,h}}^{G\to H,
    {\rm rad,tan,pre,out,per,bridge,free,short}}(s,p),
\end{aligned}
\]
and
\[
\begin{aligned}
  R_{i,j,h}^{\rm ret8}(s,p)
  &:=
  R_{i,j,h}^{\rm spr,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}(s,p)
\\
  &:=
  \mathfrak X_{
    \substack{
      Q,\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,j,\\
      2K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
      \max\{h-1,1\}}}^{G\to H,{\rm rad,ret,spr}}(s,p).
\end{aligned}
\]
Then, for all \(p\) sufficiently close to \(\pc(H)\), the finite ladder of
Corollary~\ref{cor:confined-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}
remains valid after replacing the confined bridge contribution
\[
  \sum_{i=0}^{N-1}
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
  \sum_{j=0}^{J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}-1}

  P_{i,j,h}^{\rm br8}
\]
by
\[
\begin{aligned}
  &\sum_{i=0}^{N-1}
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
  \sum_{j=0}^{J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}-1}
  \sum_{h=1}^{B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}}
  P_{i,j,h}^{\rm ifr8}
\\
  &\quad+
  \sum_{i=0}^{N-1}
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
  \sum_{j=0}^{J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}-1}
  \sum_{h=1}^{B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}}
  R_{i,j,h}^{\rm ret8}.
\end{aligned}
\]
All other terms from that finite ladder, including the adjacent return-spread
family \(R_{i,j}^{\rm spr8}\), the seventh bridge-return spread family
\(R_{i,j,h}^{\rm ret7}\), all retained older return-spread and bridge-return
families, confined fixed-gap staircase and bridge profiles, long-run
profiles, enlarged spread-return profiles, and exact-level return profiles,
are unchanged.  Consequently, the exponent hypothesis on the initial far tail
follows from the same exponent hypothesis on the terminal far tail, the finite
bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record inward-free
bridge profiles, the new bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-
record-record bridge-return spread profiles, the retained return-spread and
bridge-return profiles named above, confined fixed-gap staircase and bridge
profiles, long-run profiles, enlarged spread-return profiles, and ordinary
exact-level exterior-return profiles.
\end{corollary}

\begin{proof}
Apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:confined-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.
For each \(i,j,h\), apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:confined-bridges-inward-free-or-returning} with
\[
  (\lambda,\sigma,\beta,K,L)
  =
  (\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i).
\]
This gives
\[
  P_{i,j,h}^{\rm br8}(s,p)
  \le
  P_{i,j,h}^{\rm ifr8}(s,p)
  +
  R_{i,j,h}^{\rm ret8}(s,p).
\]
Substituting into the confined bridge sum with coefficient
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
gives the displayed replacement.  The added \(h\)-sum is finite and
independent of \(p\), and no new nonconstant multiplicative loss is introduced.
\end{proof}

\begin{corollary}[Eighth record-absorbed finite ladder]
\label{cor:record-absorbed-inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}

Corollary~\ref{cor:inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder},

\[

  P_{i,j}^{\rm pre,rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}(s,p)

\[
\begin{aligned}
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}

\\

  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\\
  &\quad\cdot

\\

Then the finite ladder of

by

  \sum_{i=0}^{N-1}
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
  \sum_{j=0}^{J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}-1}

\]
and after replacing the long-run coefficient
\[

\]
by
\[
  A_i^{\rm long,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}.
\]
All other terms from that finite ladder, including the eighth bridge-return
spread family \(R_{i,j,h}^{\rm ret8}\), the adjacent return-spread family
\(R_{i,j}^{\rm spr8}\), all retained older return-spread and bridge-return
families, confined fixed-gap staircase and bridge profiles, enlarged
spread-return profiles, and exact-level return profiles, are unchanged.
Consequently, the exponent hypothesis on the initial far tail follows from

prefix-record profiles, the retained return-spread and bridge-return profiles
named above, confined fixed-gap staircase and bridge profiles, long-run
profiles, enlarged spread-return profiles, and ordinary exact-level

\end{corollary}

\begin{proof}
Apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.
For each \(i,j,h\), apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:inward-free-bridges-are-chains-or-long-runs} with
\[
  (\lambda,\sigma,\beta,K,L)
  =
  (\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    2K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i).
\]
This gives
\[
\begin{aligned}
  &P_{i,j,h}^{\rm pre,br,free,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}(s,p)
\\
  &\quad\le
  \mathfrak P_{
    \substack{
      Q,\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,j,\\
      2K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},
      L_i,h+1}}^{G\to H,
    {\rm rad,tan,pre,out,per,stair,loc,chain,short}}(s,p)
\\
  &\qquad+
  W_{\beta_i,p}\,T_{i,j}^{\rm long}(s,p).
\end{aligned}
\]
Since \(h+1\ge2\),
Corollary~\ref{cor:locally-short-staircase-chains-are-prefix-record-spread}
with \(\ell=h+1\) bounds the chain profile by \(P_{i,j}^{\rm rec8}\).
Substituting these inequalities into the inward-free bridge sum with
coefficient
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
gives \(D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}\)
copies of the prefix-record profile and the same number of additional copies
of \(W_{\beta_i,p}T_{i,j}^{\rm long}\).  Combining these with the existing
long-run coefficient
\[
  A_i^{\rm long,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
gives the displayed replacement.
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}

\\

\\

because the persistent-prefix threshold \(2K\) and return threshold \(4K\)

\]
prefix-record term gives the displayed replacement.  No long-run coefficient

\begin{proof}
Apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:persistent-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.
For each \(i,j\), apply

Corollary~\ref{cor:ordered-ladders-have-bounded-successor-gaps} with the same

\\

\\

\]
the two inequalities give
\[
  P_{i,j}^{\rm per8}(s,p)

\]

\[

loss is introduced.

remains valid after replacing the bounded-gap prefix-pair contribution
\[
  \sum_{i=0}^{N-1}

Corollary~\ref{cor:persistent-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}
remains valid after replacing the persistent-prefix contribution
\[
  \sum_{i=0}^{N-1}
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
  \sum_{j=0}^{J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}-1}
  P_{i,j}^{\rm per9}
\]
by
\[
  \sum_{i=0}^{N-1}
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
  \sum_{j=0}^{J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}-1}
  P_{i,j}^{\rm pair10}.
\]
All other terms from that finite ladder, including the adjacent return-spread
family \(R_{i,j}^{\rm spr10}\), the ninth bridge-return spread family
\(R_{i,j,h}^{\rm ret9}\), all retained older return-spread and bridge-return
families, confined fixed-gap staircase and bridge profiles, long-run
profiles, enlarged spread-return profiles, and exact-level return profiles,
are unchanged.  Consequently, the exponent hypothesis on the initial far tail
follows from the same exponent hypothesis on the terminal far tail, the tenth
bounded-gap prefix-pair profiles, the retained return-spread and bridge-return
profiles named above, confined fixed-gap staircase and bridge profiles,
long-run profiles, enlarged spread-return profiles, and ordinary exact-level
exterior-return profiles.
\end{corollary}

\begin{proof}
Apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:persistent-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.
For each \(i,j\), apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:persistent-prefix-levels-form-ordered-ladders} with
\[
  (\lambda,\sigma,\beta,K,L)
  =
  (\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    4K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i).
\]
Then apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:ordered-ladders-have-bounded-successor-gaps} with the same
parameters.  Since the bounded-successor reduction doubles \(K\), and
\[
\begin{aligned}
  &B_{\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    4K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}}
\\
  &\quad=
  \left\lceil
    \frac{
      64K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}\beta_i
    }{\Theta_i}
  \right\rceil+1
\\
  &\quad=
  B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},
\end{aligned}
\]
the two inequalities give
\[
  P_{i,j}^{\rm per9}(s,p)
  \le
  P_{i,j}^{\rm pair10}(s,p).
\]
Substituting this into the coefficient
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
persistent-prefix term gives the displayed replacement.  The new cutoff is
fixed by the finite ladder parameters, and no new nonconstant multiplicative
loss is introduced.
\end{proof}

by

\\

\begin{proof}

Corollary~\ref{cor:bounded-gap-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.
For each \(i,j\), apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:bounded-gap-pairs-have-fixed-gap} with
\[
\begin{gathered}
  \lambda=\lambda_i,\qquad \sigma=\sigma_i,\qquad
  \beta=\beta_i,\qquad L=L_i,\\
  K=8K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},\\

\end{proof}

\label{cor:persistent-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}
In the setting of

use the notation from that corollary.  For
\(0\le j<J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}\), write
\[
\begin{aligned}
  P_{i,j}^{\rm per10}(s,p)
  &:=
  P_{i,j}^{\rm pre,per,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}(s,p)
\\
  &:=
  \mathfrak P_{
    \substack{
      Q,\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,j,\\
      4K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i}
    }^{G\to H,{\rm rad,tan,pre,out,per,short}}(s,p),
\end{aligned}
\]
and, for \(0\le j\le J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}\), write
\[
\begin{aligned}
  R_{i,j}^{\rm spr11}(s,p)
  &:=
  R_{i,j}^{\rm spr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}(s,p)
\\
  &:=
  \mathfrak X_{
    \substack{
      Q,\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,j,\\
      8K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}}
    }^{G\to H,{\rm rad,ret,spr}}(s,p).
\end{aligned}
\]
Then, for all \(p\) sufficiently close to \(\pc(H)\), the finite ladder of
Corollary~\ref{cor:record-absorbed-inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}
remains valid after replacing the prefix-record contribution
\[
\begin{aligned}
  &\sum_{i=0}^{N-1}
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\\
  &\quad{}\cdot
  \sum_{j=0}^{J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}-1}
  P_{i,j}^{\rm rec10}
\end{aligned}
\]
by
\[
\begin{aligned}
  &\sum_{i=0}^{N-1}
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\\
  &\quad{}\cdot
  \sum_{j=0}^{J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}-1}
  P_{i,j}^{\rm per10}
\\
  &\quad+
  \sum_{i=0}^{N-1}
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\\
  &\quad{}\cdot
  \sum_{j=0}^{J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}-1}
  R_{i,j}^{\rm spr11}
\\
  &\quad+
  \sum_{i=0}^{N-1}
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\\
  &\quad{}\cdot
  \sum_{j=0}^{J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}-1}
  R_{i,j+1}^{\rm spr11}.
\end{aligned}
\]
All other terms from that finite ladder, including the tenth bridge-return
spread family \(R_{i,j,h}^{\rm ret10}\), the adjacent return-spread family
\(R_{i,j}^{\rm spr10}\), the ninth bridge-return spread family
\(R_{i,j,h}^{\rm ret9}\), all retained older return-spread and bridge-return
families, confined fixed-gap staircase and bridge profiles, long-run profiles,
enlarged spread-return profiles, and exact-level return profiles, are
unchanged.  Consequently, the exponent hypothesis on the initial far tail
follows from the same exponent hypothesis on the terminal far tail, the
eleventh persistent prefix profiles, the new eleventh return-spread profiles,
the retained return-spread and bridge-return profiles named above, confined
fixed-gap staircase and bridge profiles, long-run profiles, enlarged
spread-return profiles, and ordinary exact-level exterior-return profiles.

\begin{proof}
Apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:record-absorbed-inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.
For each \(i,j\), apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:short-prefix-record-spread-persistent-return-split} with
\[
  (\lambda,\sigma,\beta,K,L)
  =
  (\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    2K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i).
\]
This gives
\[
\begin{aligned}
  P_{i,j}^{\rm rec10}(s,p)
  \le&\;
  P_{i,j}^{\rm per10}(s,p)
\\
  &+
  R_{i,j}^{\rm spr11}(s,p)
\\
  &+
  R_{i,j+1}^{\rm spr11}(s,p),
\end{aligned}
\]
because the persistent-prefix threshold \(2K\) and return threshold \(4K\)
in the general split become
\[
\begin{gathered}
  4K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},\\
  8K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}.
\end{gathered}
\]
Substituting into the coefficient
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
prefix-record term gives the displayed replacement.  No long-run coefficient
changes in this split.
\end{proof}

\begin{corollary}[Eleventh bounded-gap finite ladder]
\label{cor:bounded-gap-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}
In the setting of
Corollary~\ref{cor:persistent-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder},
use the notation from that corollary.  Put
\[
  \Theta_i=\theta_{\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i}
\]
and
\[
\begin{aligned}
  &B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\\
  &\quad:=
  \left\lceil
    \frac{64\beta_i}{\Theta_i}\,
    K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
  \right\rceil+1 .
\end{aligned}
\]
For \(0\le j<J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}\), write
\[
\begin{aligned}
  P_{i,j}^{\rm pair11}(s,p)
  &:=
  P_{i,j}^{\rm pre,pair,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}(s,p)
\\
  &:=
  \mathfrak P_{
    \substack{
      Q,\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,j,\\
      8K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i,\\
      B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}}}^{G\to H,
    {\rm rad,tan,pre,out,per,pair,short}}(s,p).
\end{aligned}
\]
Then, for all \(p\) sufficiently close to \(\pc(H)\), the finite ladder of
Corollary~\ref{cor:persistent-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}
remains valid after replacing the persistent-prefix contribution
\[
\begin{aligned}
  &\sum_{i=0}^{N-1}
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\\
  &\quad{}\cdot
  \sum_{j=0}^{J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}-1}
  P_{i,j}^{\rm per10}
\end{aligned}
\]
by
\[
\begin{aligned}
  &\sum_{i=0}^{N-1}
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\\
  &\quad{}\cdot
  \sum_{j=0}^{J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}-1}
  P_{i,j}^{\rm pair11}.
\end{aligned}
\]
All other terms from that finite ladder, including the adjacent return-spread
family \(R_{i,j}^{\rm spr11}\), the tenth bridge-return spread family
\(R_{i,j,h}^{\rm ret10}\), the adjacent return-spread family
\(R_{i,j}^{\rm spr10}\), all retained older return-spread and bridge-return
families, confined fixed-gap staircase and bridge profiles, long-run
profiles, enlarged spread-return profiles, and exact-level return profiles,
are unchanged.  Consequently, the exponent hypothesis on the initial far tail
follows from the same exponent hypothesis on the terminal far tail, the
eleventh bounded-gap prefix-pair profiles, the retained return-spread and
bridge-return profiles named above, confined fixed-gap staircase and bridge
profiles, long-run profiles, enlarged spread-return profiles, and ordinary
exact-level exterior-return profiles.
\end{corollary}

\begin{proof}
Apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:persistent-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.
For each \(i,j\), apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:persistent-prefix-levels-form-ordered-ladders} with
\[
  (\lambda,\sigma,\beta,K,L)
  =
  (\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    4K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i).
\]
Then apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:ordered-ladders-have-bounded-successor-gaps} with the same
parameters.  Since the bounded-successor reduction doubles \(K\), and
\[
\begin{aligned}
  &B_{\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    4K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}}
\\
  &\quad=
  \left\lceil
    \frac{
      64K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
      \beta_i
    }{\Theta_i}
  \right\rceil+1
\\
  &\quad=
  B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},
\end{aligned}
\]
the two inequalities give
\[
  P_{i,j}^{\rm per10}(s,p)
  \le
  P_{i,j}^{\rm pair11}(s,p).
\]
Substituting this into the coefficient
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
persistent-prefix term gives the displayed replacement.  The new cutoff is
fixed by the finite ladder parameters, and no new nonconstant multiplicative
loss is introduced.
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}
Apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:bounded-gap-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.
For each \(i,j\), apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:bounded-gap-pairs-have-fixed-gap} with
\[
\begin{gathered}
  \lambda=\lambda_i,\qquad \sigma=\sigma_i,\qquad
  \beta=\beta_i,\qquad L=L_i,\\
  K=8K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},\\
  B=B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}.
\end{gathered}
\]

\[
  KB=K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},
\]
this gives
\[
  P_{i,j}^{\rm pair11}(s,p)

  \sum_{h=1}^{
    B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}}

Substituting this into the coefficient
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
bounded-gap pair term gives the displayed replacement.  The added sum over
\(h\) is finite and independent of \(p\), and all other coefficients and
variable losses are unchanged.
\end{proof}

  \lambda=\lambda_i,\qquad \sigma=\sigma_i,\qquad

  K=8K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},\\
  B=B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}.
\end{gathered}
\]
Since
\[
  KB=K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},
\]
this gives
\[
  P_{i,j}^{\rm pair12}(s,p)
  \le
  \sum_{h=1}^{
    B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}}
  P_{i,j,h}^{\rm gap12}(s,p).
\]
Substituting this into the coefficient
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
bounded-gap pair term gives the displayed replacement.  The added sum over
\(h\) is finite and independent of \(p\), and all other coefficients and
variable losses are unchanged.
\end{proof}

\[

loss is introduced.

  A_i^{\rm long,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
  &:=
\\
  &\quad
  A_i^{\rm long,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\\
  &\quad+
\\
  &\quad
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}.
\end{aligned}
$}
\]
Then the finite ladder of
Corollary~\ref{cor:inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}
remains valid after replacing the inward-free bridge contribution
\[
\begin{aligned}
  &\sum_{i=0}^{N-1}

\\

    B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}}

\end{aligned}
\]
by

\]
and after replacing the long-run coefficient
\[
  A_i^{\rm long,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
by
\[
  A_i^{\rm long,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}.
\]
All other terms from that finite ladder, including the thirteenth
bridge-return spread family \(R_{i,j,h}^{\rm ret13}\), the adjacent
thirteenth return-spread family \(R_{i,j}^{\rm spr13}\), the twelfth

return-spread family \(R_{i,j}^{\rm spr12}\), all retained older
return-spread and bridge-return families, confined fixed-gap staircase and
bridge profiles, enlarged spread-return profiles, and exact-level return
profiles, are unchanged.  Consequently, the exponent hypothesis on the

profiles, long-run profiles, enlarged spread-return profiles, and ordinary

\begin{proof}
Apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.
For each \(i,j,h\), apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:inward-free-bridges-are-chains-or-long-runs} with
\[
  (\lambda,\sigma,\beta,K,L)
  =
  (\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    2K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i).
\]
This gives
\[
\begin{aligned}
  &P_{i,j,h}^{\rm pre,br,free,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}(s,p)
\\
  &\quad\le
  \mathfrak P_{
    \substack{
      Q,\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,j,\\
      2K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},
      L_i,h+1}}^{G\to H,
    {\rm rad,tan,pre,out,per,stair,loc,chain,short}}(s,p)
\\
  &\qquad+
  W_{\beta_i,p}\,T_{i,j}^{\rm long}(s,p).
\end{aligned}
\]
Since \(h+1\ge2\),
Corollary~\ref{cor:locally-short-staircase-chains-are-prefix-record-spread}
with \(\ell=h+1\) bounds the chain profile by \(P_{i,j}^{\rm rec13}\).
Substituting these inequalities into the inward-free bridge sum with
coefficient
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
gives
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
copies of the prefix-record profile and the same number of additional copies
of \(W_{\beta_i,p}T_{i,j}^{\rm long}\).  Combining these with the existing
long-run coefficient
\[
  A_i^{\rm long,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
gives the displayed replacement.
\end{proof}

\begin{corollary}[Fourteenth persistent finite ladder]
\label{cor:persistent-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}
In the setting of
Corollary~\ref{cor:record-absorbed-inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder},

\\

\end{aligned}
\]
and, for \(0\le j\le J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}\), write

  R_{i,j}^{\rm spr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}(s,p)
\\
  &:=
  \mathfrak X_{
    \substack{
      Q,\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,j,\\
      8K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}}
    }^{G\to H,{\rm rad,ret,spr}}(s,p).
\end{aligned}
\]
Then, for all \(p\) sufficiently close to \(\pc(H)\), the finite ladder of
Corollary~\ref{cor:record-absorbed-inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}
remains valid after replacing the prefix-record contribution
\[
\begin{aligned}
  &\sum_{i=0}^{N-1}

\\
  &\quad{}\cdot
  \sum_{j=0}^{J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}-1}
  P_{i,j}^{\rm rec13}

\]

\[
\begin{aligned}

\\

\\

  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\\
  &\quad{}\cdot
  \sum_{j=0}^{J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}-1}
  R_{i,j}^{\rm spr14}
\\
  &\quad+
  \sum_{i=0}^{N-1}
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\\
  &\quad{}\cdot
  \sum_{j=0}^{J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}-1}
  R_{i,j+1}^{\rm spr14}.
\end{aligned}
\]
All other terms from that finite ladder, including the thirteenth
bridge-return spread family \(R_{i,j,h}^{\rm ret13}\), the adjacent
thirteenth return-spread family \(R_{i,j}^{\rm spr13}\), the twelfth
bridge-return spread family \(R_{i,j,h}^{\rm ret12}\), the adjacent twelfth
return-spread family \(R_{i,j}^{\rm spr12}\), all retained older
return-spread and bridge-return families, confined fixed-gap staircase and
bridge profiles, long-run profiles, enlarged spread-return profiles, and
exact-level return profiles, are unchanged.  Consequently, the exponent
hypothesis on the initial far tail follows from the same exponent hypothesis
on the terminal far tail, the persistent prefix profiles \(P^{\rm per13}\),
the new fourteenth return-spread profiles, the retained return-spread and
bridge-return profiles named above, confined fixed-gap staircase and bridge
profiles, long-run profiles, enlarged spread-return profiles, and ordinary
exact-level exterior-return profiles.
\end{corollary}

\begin{proof}
Apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:record-absorbed-inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.
For each \(i,j\), apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:short-prefix-record-spread-persistent-return-split} with
\[
  (\lambda,\sigma,\beta,K,L)
  =
  (\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    2K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i).
\]
This gives
\[
\begin{aligned}
  P_{i,j}^{\rm rec13}(s,p)
  \le&\;
  P_{i,j}^{\rm per13}(s,p)
\\
  &+
  R_{i,j}^{\rm spr14}(s,p)
\\
  &+
  R_{i,j+1}^{\rm spr14}(s,p),
\end{aligned}
\]
because the persistent-prefix threshold \(2K\) and return threshold \(4K\)
in the general split become
\[
\begin{gathered}
  4K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},\\
  8K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}.
\end{gathered}
\]
Substituting into the coefficient
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
prefix-record term gives the displayed replacement.  No long-run coefficient
changes in this split.
\end{proof}

\\
  &\quad{}\cdot
  \sum_{j=0}^{J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}-1}
  P_{i,j}^{\rm per13}
\end{aligned}
\]
by
\[
\begin{aligned}
  &\sum_{i=0}^{N-1}
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\\

\]
All other terms from that finite ladder, including the adjacent fourteenth
return-spread family \(R_{i,j}^{\rm spr14}\), the thirteenth bridge-return
spread family \(R_{i,j,h}^{\rm ret13}\), the adjacent thirteenth
return-spread family \(R_{i,j}^{\rm spr13}\), the twelfth bridge-return

family \(R_{i,j}^{\rm spr12}\), all retained older return-spread and

\begin{proof}
Apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:persistent-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.
For each \(i,j\), apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:persistent-prefix-levels-form-ordered-ladders} with
\[
  (\lambda,\sigma,\beta,K,L)
  =
  (\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    4K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i).
\]
Then apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:ordered-ladders-have-bounded-successor-gaps} with the same
parameters.  Since the bounded-successor reduction doubles \(K\), and
{\small
\[
\begin{aligned}
  &B_{\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    4K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}}
\\
  &\quad=
  \left\lceil
    \frac{64\beta_i}{\Theta_i}\,
    K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
  \right\rceil+1
\\
  &\quad=
  B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},
\end{aligned}
\]
}
the two inequalities give
\[
  P_{i,j}^{\rm per13}(s,p)
  \le
  P_{i,j}^{\rm pair14}(s,p).
\]
Substituting this into the coefficient
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
persistent-prefix term gives the displayed replacement.  The new cutoff is
fixed by the finite ladder parameters, and no new nonconstant multiplicative
loss is introduced.
\end{proof}

\[

  \mathfrak P_{

\\

\]
by
\[
\begin{aligned}
  &\sum_{i=0}^{N-1}

For each \(i,j\), apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:persistent-prefix-levels-form-ordered-ladders} with
\[
\begin{gathered}
  \lambda=\lambda_i,\qquad
  \sigma=\sigma_i,\qquad
  \beta=\beta_i,\qquad
  L=L_i,\\
  K=
  4K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}.
\end{gathered}
\]
Then apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:ordered-ladders-have-bounded-successor-gaps} with the same
parameters.  Since the bounded-successor reduction doubles \(K\), and
{\small
\[
\begin{aligned}
  &B_{\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    4K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}}
\\
  &\quad=
  \left\lceil
    \frac{64\beta_i}{\Theta_i}\,
    K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
  \right\rceil+1
\\
  &\quad=
  B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},
\end{aligned}
\]
}
the two inequalities give
\[
  P_{i,j}^{\rm per14}(s,p)
  \le
  P_{i,j}^{\rm pair15}(s,p).
\]
Substituting this into the coefficient
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
persistent-prefix term gives the displayed replacement.  The new cutoff is
fixed by the finite ladder parameters, and no new nonconstant multiplicative
loss is introduced.
\end{proof}

  &\quad\cdot
  B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},\\
  A_i^{\rm long,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
  &:=
\\
  &\quad
  A_i^{\rm long,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\\
  &\quad+
\\
  &\quad
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}.
\end{aligned}
$}
\]
Then the finite ladder of
Corollary~\ref{cor:inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}
remains valid after replacing the inward-free bridge contribution
\[
\begin{aligned}
  &\sum_{i=0}^{N-1}
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
  \sum_{j=0}^{J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}-1}
\\
  &\quad
  \sum_{h=1}^{
    B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}}
  P_{i,j,h}^{\rm ifr15}
\end{aligned}
\]
by
\[
  \sum_{i=0}^{N-1}
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
  \sum_{j=0}^{J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}-1}
  P_{i,j}^{\rm rec15},
\]
and after replacing the long-run coefficient
\[
  A_i^{\rm long,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
by
\[
  A_i^{\rm long,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}.
\]
All other terms from that finite ladder, including the fifteenth
bridge-return spread family \(R_{i,j,h}^{\rm ret15}\), the adjacent
fifteenth return-spread family \(R_{i,j}^{\rm spr15}\), the fourteenth
bridge-return spread family \(R_{i,j,h}^{\rm ret14}\), the adjacent
fourteenth return-spread family \(R_{i,j}^{\rm spr14}\), the thirteenth
bridge-return spread family \(R_{i,j,h}^{\rm ret13}\), the adjacent
thirteenth return-spread family \(R_{i,j}^{\rm spr13}\), all retained older
return-spread and bridge-return families, confined fixed-gap staircase and
bridge profiles, enlarged spread-return profiles, and exact-level return
profiles, are unchanged.  Consequently, the exponent hypothesis on the

tail, the fifteenth prefix-record profiles, the retained return-spread and
bridge-return profiles named above, confined fixed-gap staircase and bridge
profiles, long-run profiles, enlarged spread-return profiles, and ordinary
exact-level exterior-return profiles.
\end{corollary}

\begin{proof}
Apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.
For each \(i,j,h\), apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:inward-free-bridges-are-chains-or-long-runs} with
\[
\begin{gathered}
  \lambda=\lambda_i,\qquad
  \sigma=\sigma_i,\qquad
  \beta=\beta_i,\qquad
  L=L_i,\\
  K=
  2K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}.
\end{gathered}
\]
This gives
\[
\begin{aligned}
  &P_{i,j,h}^{\rm pre,br,free,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}(s,p)
\\
  &\quad\le
  \mathfrak P_{
    \substack{
      Q,\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,j,\\
      2K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},
      L_i,h+1}}^{G\to H,
    {\rm rad,tan,pre,out,per,stair,loc,chain,short}}(s,p)
\\
  &\qquad+
  W_{\beta_i,p}\,T_{i,j}^{\rm long}(s,p).
\end{aligned}
\]
Since \(h+1\ge2\),
Corollary~\ref{cor:locally-short-staircase-chains-are-prefix-record-spread}
with \(\ell=h+1\) bounds the chain profile by \(P_{i,j}^{\rm rec15}\).
Substituting these inequalities into the inward-free bridge sum with
coefficient
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
gives
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
copies of the prefix-record profile and the same number of additional copies
of \(W_{\beta_i,p}T_{i,j}^{\rm long}\).  Combining these with the existing
long-run coefficient
\[
  A_i^{\rm long,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
gives the displayed replacement.
\end{proof}

\begin{corollary}[Sixteenth persistent finite ladder]
\label{cor:persistent-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}
In the setting of
Corollary~\ref{cor:record-absorbed-inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder},
use the notation from that corollary.  For
\(0\le j<J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}\), write
{\small
\[
\begin{aligned}
  P_{i,j}^{\rm per15}(s,p)
  &:=
  P_{i,j}^{\rm pre,per,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}(s,p)
\\
  &:=
  \mathfrak P_{
    \substack{
      Q,\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,j,\\
      4K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i}
    }^{G\to H,{\rm rad,tan,pre,out,per,short}}(s,p),
\end{aligned}
\]
}
and, for \(0\le j\le J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}\), write
\[
\begin{aligned}
  R_{i,j}^{\rm spr16}(s,p)
  &:=
  R_{i,j}^{\rm spr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}(s,p)
\\
  &:=
  \mathfrak X_{
    \substack{
      Q,\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,j,\\
      8K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}}
    }^{G\to H,{\rm rad,ret,spr}}(s,p).
\end{aligned}
\]
Then, for all \(p\) sufficiently close to \(\pc(H)\), the finite ladder of
Corollary~\ref{cor:record-absorbed-inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}
remains valid after replacing the prefix-record contribution
\[
\begin{aligned}
  &\sum_{i=0}^{N-1}
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\\
  &\quad{}\cdot
  \sum_{j=0}^{J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}-1}
  P_{i,j}^{\rm rec15}
\end{aligned}
\]
by
\[
\begin{aligned}
  &\sum_{i=0}^{N-1}
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\\
  &\quad{}\cdot
  \sum_{j=0}^{J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}-1}
  P_{i,j}^{\rm per15}
\\
  &\quad+
  \sum_{i=0}^{N-1}
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\\
  &\quad{}\cdot
  \sum_{j=0}^{J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}-1}
  R_{i,j}^{\rm spr16}
\\
  &\quad+
  \sum_{i=0}^{N-1}
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\\
  &\quad{}\cdot
  \sum_{j=0}^{J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}-1}
  R_{i,j+1}^{\rm spr16}.
\end{aligned}
\]
All other terms from that finite ladder, including the fifteenth
bridge-return spread family \(R_{i,j,h}^{\rm ret15}\), the adjacent
fifteenth return-spread family \(R_{i,j}^{\rm spr15}\), the fourteenth
bridge-return spread family \(R_{i,j,h}^{\rm ret14}\), the adjacent
fourteenth return-spread family \(R_{i,j}^{\rm spr14}\), all retained older
return-spread and bridge-return families, confined fixed-gap staircase and
bridge profiles, long-run profiles, enlarged spread-return profiles, and
exact-level return profiles, are unchanged.  Consequently, the exponent
hypothesis on the initial far tail follows from the same exponent hypothesis
on the terminal far tail, the persistent prefix profiles \(P^{\rm per15}\),
the new sixteenth return-spread profiles, the retained return-spread and
bridge-return profiles named above, confined fixed-gap staircase and bridge
profiles, long-run profiles, enlarged spread-return profiles, and ordinary
exact-level exterior-return profiles.
\end{corollary}

\begin{proof}
Apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:record-absorbed-inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.
For each \(i,j\), apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:short-prefix-record-spread-persistent-return-split} with
\[
\begin{gathered}
  \lambda=\lambda_i,\qquad
  \sigma=\sigma_i,\qquad
  \beta=\beta_i,\qquad
  L=L_i,\\
  K=
  2K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}.
\end{gathered}
\]
This gives
\[
\begin{aligned}
  P_{i,j}^{\rm rec15}(s,p)
  \le&\;
  P_{i,j}^{\rm per15}(s,p)
\\
  &+
  R_{i,j}^{\rm spr16}(s,p)
\\
  &+
  R_{i,j+1}^{\rm spr16}(s,p),
\end{aligned}
\]
because the persistent-prefix threshold \(2K\) and return threshold \(4K\)
in the general split become
\[
\begin{gathered}
  4K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},\\
  8K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}.
\end{gathered}
\]
Substituting into the coefficient
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
prefix-record term gives the displayed replacement.  No long-run coefficient
changes in this split.
\end{proof}

\begin{corollary}[Sixteenth bounded-gap finite ladder]
\label{cor:bounded-gap-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}
In the setting of
Corollary~\ref{cor:persistent-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder},

and

\\

  \mathfrak P_{

      8K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},L_i,\\

remains valid after replacing the persistent-prefix contribution

\\
  &\quad{}\cdot
  \sum_{j=0}^{J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}-1}
  P_{i,j}^{\rm per15}
\end{aligned}
\]
by
\[
\begin{aligned}
  &\sum_{i=0}^{N-1}
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\\

  \sum_{j=0}^{J_{\sigma_i,\beta_i}-1}

\end{aligned}
\]
All other terms from that finite ladder, including the adjacent sixteenth
return-spread family, the fifteenth bridge-return and adjacent return-spread
families, the fourteenth bridge-return and adjacent return-spread families,
all retained older return-spread and bridge-return families, confined

\begin{proof}
Apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:persistent-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.
For each \(i,j\), apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:persistent-prefix-levels-form-ordered-ladders} with
\[
\begin{gathered}
  \lambda=\lambda_i,\qquad
  \sigma=\sigma_i,\qquad
  \beta=\beta_i,\qquad
  L=L_i,\\
  K=
  4K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}.
\end{gathered}
\]
Then apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:ordered-ladders-have-bounded-successor-gaps} with the same
parameters.  Since the bounded-successor reduction doubles \(K\), and
{\small
\[
\begin{aligned}
  &B_{\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    4K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}}
\\
  &\quad=
  \left\lceil
    \frac{64\beta_i}{\Theta_i}\,
    K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
  \right\rceil+1
\\
  &\quad=
  B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},
\end{aligned}
\]
}
the two inequalities give
\[
  P_{i,j}^{\rm per15}(s,p)
  \le
  P_{i,j}^{\rm pair16}(s,p).
\]
Substituting this into the coefficient
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
persistent-prefix term gives the displayed replacement.  The new cutoff is
fixed by the finite ladder parameters, and no new nonconstant multiplicative
loss is introduced.
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}

\begin{proof}

}
by
{\small
\[
\begin{aligned}

\\

}

\begin{proof}

For each \(i,j\), apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:persistent-prefix-levels-form-ordered-ladders} with
\[
\begin{gathered}
  \lambda=\lambda_i,\qquad
  \sigma=\sigma_i,\qquad
  \beta=\beta_i,\qquad
  L=L_i,\\
  K=
  4K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}.
\end{gathered}
\]
Then apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:ordered-ladders-have-bounded-successor-gaps} with the same
parameters.  Since the bounded-successor reduction doubles \(K\), and
{\small
\[
\begin{aligned}
  &B_{\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,
    4K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}}
\\
  &\quad=

    \frac{64\beta_i}{\Theta_i}\,
    K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
  \right\rceil+1
\\
  &\quad=
  B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},
\end{aligned}
\]
}
the two inequalities give
\[
  P_{i,j}^{\rm per16}(s,p)
  \le
  P_{i,j}^{\rm pair17}(s,p).
\]
Substituting this into the coefficient
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
persistent-prefix term gives the displayed replacement.  The new cutoff is
fixed by the finite ladder parameters, and no new nonconstant multiplicative
loss is introduced.
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}
Apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:inward-free-bridge-persistent-record-absorbed-inward-free-bridge-persistent-record-absorbed-inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.
For each \(i,j,h\), apply
Corollary~\ref{cor:inward-free-bridges-are-chains-or-long-runs} with
\[
\begin{gathered}
  \lambda=\lambda_i,\qquad
  \sigma=\sigma_i,\qquad
  \beta=\beta_i,\qquad
  L=L_i,\\
  K=
  2K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}.
\end{gathered}
\]
This gives
\[
\resizebox{\textwidth}{!}{$
\begin{aligned}
  &P_{i,j,h}^{\rm pre,br,free,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}(s,p)
\\
  &\quad\le
  \mathfrak P_{
    \substack{
      Q,\lambda_i,\sigma_i,\beta_i,j,\\
      2K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},
      L_i,h+1}}^{G\to H,
    {\rm rad,tan,pre,out,per,stair,loc,chain,short}}(s,p)
  +
  W_{\beta_i,p}\,T_{i,j}^{\rm long}(s,p).
\end{aligned}
$}
\]
Since \(h+1\ge2\),
Corollary~\ref{cor:locally-short-staircase-chains-are-prefix-record-spread}
with \(\ell=h+1\) bounds the chain profile by \(P_{i,j}^{\rm rec18}\).
Substituting these inequalities into the inward-free bridge sum with
coefficient
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
gives
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
copies of the prefix-record profile and the same number of additional copies
of \(W_{\beta_i,p}T_{i,j}^{\rm long}\).  Combining these with the existing
long-run coefficient
\[
  A_i^{\rm long,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
gives the displayed replacement.
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}

Corollary~\ref{cor:record-absorbed-inward-free-bridge-persistent-record-absorbed-inward-free-bridge-persistent-record-absorbed-inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.

loss is introduced.
\end{proof}

  8K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},\\
  B=

\end{gathered}
\]
Since
\[
\resizebox{\textwidth}{!}{$
  KB=
  K_i^{\rm gap,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch},
$}
\]
this gives
\[
\resizebox{\textwidth}{!}{$
  P_{i,j}^{\rm pair19}(s,p)
  \le
  \sum_{h=1}^{
    B_i^{\rm br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}}
  P_{i,j,h}^{\rm gap19}(s,p).
$}
\]
Substituting this into the coefficient
\[
  D_i^{\rm rec,br,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,recbr,ch}
\]
bounded-gap pair term gives the displayed replacement.  The added sum over
\(h\) is finite and independent of \(p\), and all other coefficients and
variable losses are unchanged.
\end{proof}

\begin{corollary}[Nineteenth confined bridge finite ladder]
\label{cor:confined-bridge-persistent-record-absorbed-inward-free-bridge-persistent-record-absorbed-inward-free-bridge-persistent-record-absorbed-inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}

\begin{proof}

gives the displayed replacement.  No new variable coefficient is introduced,

\end{proof}

\begin{corollary}[Nineteenth inward-free bridge finite ladder]
\label{cor:inward-free-bridge-persistent-record-absorbed-inward-free-bridge-persistent-record-absorbed-inward-free-bridge-persistent-record-absorbed-inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}

\\

\begin{proof}

Corollary~\ref{cor:confined-bridge-persistent-record-absorbed-inward-free-bridge-persistent-record-absorbed-inward-free-bridge-persistent-record-absorbed-inward-free-bridge-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-record-chain-absorbed-staircase-chain-bridge-reduced-finite-far-tail-ladder}.

Corollary~\ref{cor:confined-bridges-inward-free-or-returning} with
\[
\resizebox{\textwidth}{!}{$
\begin{gathered}
  \lambda=\lambda_i,\qquad
  \sigma=\sigma_i,\qquad
  \beta=\beta_i,\qquad
